newsitem.title: FRANCE: Big block of Suez traded off floor.
newsitem.headline: Big block of Suez traded off floor.

text.p: A block of five million Cie de Suez shares, representing 3.05 percent of the capital, was traded off-market on Tuesday evening, the French stockmarkets association SBF said on Wednesday.
The trade was carried out at 285 francs per share for a total of 1.43 billion francs.
Suez officials were not immediately available for comment.

Glassmaker Saint-Gobain recently said it would sell part of its 6.3 percent Suez stake but officials at the company were not immediately available. Suez shares were down 0.84 percent at 283.60 francs at 1028 GMT.
